ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary headings, body text, and icon fills on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary text, heading color, deep UI surfaces — slightly warmer than pure black

slate-mid.$description: Slate Mid — Body text, helper copy, muted descriptions

ash.$description: Ash — Icon strokes, subtle heading tint, gradient base color for the shimmer effect; Decorative text/divider gradient — silver base with brief green and periwinkle flash at 35-40%

fog.$description: Fog — Hairline borders across cards, inputs, images, and dividers

mist.$description: Mist — Card borders, softer structural lines

pebble.$description: Pebble — Disabled button background, body borders — the lightest non-surface gray

cloud.$description: Cloud — Elevated surface tier, button borders, subtle fills

snow.$description: Snow — Card surface background — one step off white for gentle separation

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, input fields, icon fills, reversed text on dark elements

fern.$description: Fern — Accent text, decorative punctuation in body copy, gradient flash color — the only chromatic voice, rationed carefully

mint-wash.$description: Mint Wash — Pale green surface tint, decorative wash blocks

inter.$description: Primary UI typeface — body, nav links, buttons, inputs, captions, and subheadings across the interface

instrument-serif.$description: Wordmark and editorial accents — the italic 'Anything' logo is the system's signature gesture, replacing the standard bold-sans brand mark with something handwritten and human

instrument-sans.$description: Display and heading typeface — 42px weight 600 carries the hero headline, sharing DNA with Instrument Serif so the serif/sans pairing feels intentional rather than mixed
